title: Luxuriant Dense Irish Prune Casserole
description: A rich and satisfying Irish dish featuring prunes, perfect for a midnight craving, made with shojin-friendly ingredients and finished with a flambe touch.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the oatmeal, brown sugar, and melted butter, mixing until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and vanilla extract.
Add the prunes to the egg mixture and stir until they are fully coated.
Add the egg and prune mixture to the oatmeal mixture, stirring until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.
While the casserole is baking, heat the whiskey in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the casserole is done, remove it from the oven and flambe the top with the heated whiskey.
Return the casserole to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Drizzle the heavy cream over the top of the casserole before serving.
